in_marathi.name: Soyam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Soyam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Soyam is a soothing, calming name derived from Sanskrit and Hindi, meaning 'that which soothes'. It is a name inspired by the calming and nourishing qualities of water and the sun.
